summary: The analysis identified a high-risk malicious VBA macro in a document, with indicators of command-and-control communication and potential payload delivery. Additionally, the web analysis revealed multiple missing security headers, increasing exposure to web-based attacks.

findings.detail: 2 VBA macro module(s) found in invoice.docm (OpenXML). Flags: auto_exec, has_ioc, suspicious.

findings.evidence:
--- Module: Module1 (stream: Macros/Module1) ---
Sub AutoOpen()
End Sub

findings.detail: IP geolocation: country=Singapore, ISP=Amazon.com, Inc., AS=AS16509 Amazon.com, Inc.

recommendations: Isolate any host that opened the document and block http://recongraph.xyz at the egress proxy.
Deploy the generated YARA and SIGMA rules to EDR and SIEM respectively.
Add the missing Content-Security-Policy and other security headers to the web service.

threat_summary.threat_name: Macro-delivered downloader with HTTP payload delivery
threat_summary.attack_vector: Spearphishing attachment with malicious VBA macro
attack_chain: Step 1: Victim opens invoice.docm and enables macros
Step 2: AutoOpen executes PowerShell to download payload.exe
threat_summary.reasoning: The document contains an AutoOpen macro that launches a hidden PowerShell downloader for a remote executable. ThreatFox independently associates the domain with MintsLoader. Confidence is high because the IOC is corroborated by two independent sources.

yara.reasoning: Rules were derived from the observed VBA auto-exec entry point and the embedded URL string.

rules.description: Detects the observed payload delivery URL inside Office documents
rules.reasoning: The string http://recongraph.xyz/payload.exe was found in the olevba IOC output.
rules.rule_text:
rule SecFlow_Malware_EmbeddedString {
  meta:
    description = "Detects observed payload URL"
    author = "SecFlow AI"
    date = "2026-01-01"
    severity = "high"
    reference = "SecFlow automated analysis"
  strings:
    $s1 = "http://recongraph.xyz/payload.exe"
  condition:
    any of them
}

sigma.reasoning: Rules cover process creation for the PowerShell downloader and DNS lookups for the C2 domain.

rules.description: Detects PowerShell downloading a remote executable
rules.reasoning: AutoOpen macro launched powershell with iwr against the observed URL.
rules.rule_text:
title: Detect PowerShell Download
id: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111

description: Detects PowerShell downloading a remote executable
